structural_feasibility.interpretation: 123 is maximum combinatorial capacity at cap 8 before semantic/inventory review, not 123 qualified examples and not a guarantee for the fixed sampler. Approved research counts are currently zero; historical human decisions are review evidence, not a release.

selection_and_separation.type_key: For grouping only, NFKC + casefold; remove Unicode whitespace and the characters ASCII single/double quote, ״, ׳, “, ”, ‘, ’. Do not alter the raw target input or sentence. A type key is the normalized stored acronym, not a context-derived base.
selection_and_separation.family_guard: Build connected components over all stored type keys. Connect x to x[1:] only if len(x)>=3, first character is in ובכלמשה, and the shorter key exists. Use sorted component members serialized as compact ensure_ascii=False JSON, SHA256 first 24 hex with family- prefix. This is a conservative leakage screen, not a linguistic merge or an alias rule; it can reject unrelated words. Freeze the vocabulary at this snapshot.
selection_and_separation.split_policy: Keep historical type assignments. Natural-dev proposals are development only. All 16 pilot IDs remain development/training evidence and can never become test. Exclude from prospective test any family present in historical dev, natural-dev or pilot, and any document present there. Exclude training rows from all historical dev/test or natural-dev documents and families, even if some held-out rows later fail review. Do not move rejected items across splits.
selection_and_separation.documents: Retain existing doc_id/source-title identity; missing or unresolved document identity makes an item ineligible. Resolve known aliases before freeze. Use one occurrence per document in each final dev/test set; training may contain several same-document occurrences. Hash/text duplicate checks and document-alias validation remain a future release gate, not assumed done by the metadata counts.
selection_and_separation.test_source_population: Historical test role, natural Knesset/wiki_natural categories, no existing scope exclusion proposal, then structural family/document guards. This defines a future candidate population; it is not a selected test release.
selection_and_separation.ranking: Hash UTF-8 seed|domain|value with SHA256, hex ascending and raw value as collision tie-break. Domains: test-type with normalized type key; test-item with stable_item_id; dev-type/dev-item analogously. No label, sense frequency, inventory size, or model score ranks test occurrences. Existing stable IDs are treated as opaque hashes.
future_test_qualification_algorithm: Only after approval to access test content: group the structural candidates by normalized type key and sort types/items by the fixed hashes. Freeze these queues before semantic review.

First coverage pass: in type order, examine items until the first qualified occurrence with an unused document is obtained or that type queue is exhausted. Continue across all types, subject to the 160-examined-item ceiling. Require at least 20 represented types AND 20 conservative families before filling.

Fill passes: cycle through the same type order, each pass adding at most one qualified occurrence per type whose accepted count is below 8. Advance each fixed item queue, never re-examine a rejected row; skip already-used documents without semantic review. Stop immediately at 100 admitted occurrences.

Qualify the complete supported type inventory once when a type is first reached; count every semantically examined occurrence including rejects/uncertain toward 160. A rejected type inventory excludes that type; it does not permit borrowing a new candidate from the sentence.

If 160 examinations, queue exhaustion, a structural impasse, or fewer than 20 types/families prevents 100 admissions, stop and report the exact shortfall. Do not search alternate seeds, change caps, expose scores or hand-pick replacements. Shaked may authorize a separate extension of the review budget; no automatic fallback changes the rule.
selection_and_separation.development: Use the existing 62 natural-dev proposals, with known uncertain/exclusion records and definition flags held (59 remain structurally). Same hash round-robin and one-document rule, cap 4/type, target 24; exhaust the 59-candidate envelope if necessary. Minimum runnable-development gate: 16 qualified occurrences across 6 types, including at least 8 multi-candidate occurrences for encoder development loss. If unmet, return to Shaked without changing type assignments.
selection_and_separation.training: Use only historically reviewed natural Knesset train occurrences with complete provenance, outside reserved documents/families, without enumerated critical flags or recorded uncertain/exclude_proposed decisions, and excluding the six specifically documented occurrence holds. No substituted, deglossed, manual or AI rows in core training. There are 210 metadata candidates in 66 raw types after these gates; restrict to 38 types having >=3 candidates (177 rows). Order types by descending eligible occurrence count, then SHA256(seed|train-type|raw_acronym), then raw acronym. First 30 types are the priority envelope (153 rows); other 8 are ordered reserves (24 rows). Qualify types in that order; accept the first 30 with >=3 qualified occurrences and >=2 independent valid candidates. Include all qualified occurrences of an admitted type, up to 8 by hash(seed|train-item|stable_item_id). Stop at 30 types or reserve exhaustion; minimum training gate is 100 qualified occurrences across 20 types. These are pragmatic run-readiness thresholds, not evidence of adequate learning or power.
selection_and_separation.no_new_pilot: Existing pilot membership, order and initial answers never change; review queue membership is not human pilot membership.
selection_and_separation.human_decision_veto: Before ranking/qualification in every split, recorded uncertain or exclude_proposed occurrence decisions (overall, label or target) veto eligibility even when legacy automatic flags are clear. Recorded corrections and spans remain authoritative evidence; unresolved proposed corrections are not applied. Scope rows never override review_decisions.

qualification_and_reuse.ben: Reuse exact linked prior records only after stable identity/source match. A clean verdict is a starting label judgment. Every participating occurrence still needs a brief current-task check of linguistic expansion, intended full target, unchanged natural sentence, provenance and approved inventory coverage. Do not request another blind answer or infer independent double annotation.
qualification_and_reuse.shaked: Carry all 16 decisions and approved spans verbatim. In particular, BAH initial answer and label/target decisions remain distinct. Approved corrections are not reopened; application needs separate authority. Exclusion proposals remain recorded proposals until that application.
qualification_and_reuse.eligibility: Exactly one context-valid gold meaning for the marked occurrence; natural unmodified sentence; full target boundary; resolved source/document; no explicit in-sentence expansion under the proposed core rule; approved independent inventory with gold coverage; no unresolved semantic/provenance defect. A proper name may qualify if it is a valid linguistic expansion, not merely an entity description. Recorded uncertain/exclude_proposed decisions veto every split before ranking, independently of automatic flags; the explicitly documented additional holds are proposals, not new human decisions.
qualification_and_reuse.bounded_uncertainty: For an unresolved case, inspect existing linked evidence and at most one additional primary-source page in a later authorized review. If the answer or inventory remains materially ambiguous, mark held_for_release in a future release ledger and skip under the fixed queue. Keep review_decisions uncertain; no silent scientific adjudication or unbounded search.
qualification_and_reuse.inventory_work: Review only types actually reached in training/dev/future test queues. Consolidate each type into one decision group with source pointers, distinct linguistic meanings and proposed aliases. Do not count each sentence as another inventory task. All exported hypotheses for a participating type must receive a disposition, but only supported meanings become candidates. A materially unresolved plausible meaning holds the type; obvious event/place titles and numerals can be rejected under an approved rubric. No global requirement to resolve all 95 pilot hypotheses.
qualification_and_reuse.independence: Inventory evidence must be independent of the particular evaluated sentence and its stored gold. A copied export marked human_review is not automatically an independent source; trace its provenance. Same upstream export repeated across files is one source, not corroboration.
qualification_and_reuse.singleton_policy: Keep valid singleton inventories in evaluation/dev and report their count plus descriptive multi-candidate stratum; no invented distractors. Exclude singleton types from encoder pair training. All five conditions retain the same evaluation universe, including singleton items. Encoder argmax over one candidate is documented as structurally trivial.

known_case_recommendations.recommendation: Preserve accepted נכסי רכישה but exclude the explicit-definition occurrence from the core; do not erase its sentence or ask for a new answer. Other occurrences of this type require independent inventory support.
Keep Rambam uncertain and outside the focused release unless independently resolved during the bounded queue; no item adjudication is needed to start implementation.
Keep SUP/SAP case uncertain; it is wiki_natural outside the chosen Knesset training source, so not a core training blocker.
Keep MaharY uncertain; substituted dev is outside natural development, so defer without forcing a new expansion.
Preserve BAH accepted label and corrected full surface; manual example is outside the natural core, so provenance resolution is deferred.
Honor recorded exclusion proposals in a later approved application; no repeated approval of their registration. Exclusion is occurrence-specific, not whole-type removal.

Propose two linguistic meanings: קרן קיימת לישראל and קילו קלוריה; merge קילו־קלוריה as an explicit spelling alias. Exclude fund description, road/interchange titles and numeral. CSV rows contain exact independent source references.

Retain the supported Eilat-Ashkelon expansion proposal, reject event/port titles and numeral, and distinguish the Europe-Asia hypothesis pending bounded independent confirmation. Do not merge company names automatically.
Preserve accepted labels and full surfaces; do not infer an אגף מבצעים alias or strip ה. Reject unexpanded business titles/numerals; examine independently exported alternative linguistic meanings.

Targeted inspection of these four non-test sentences found numeric/body-parts uses of רמ״ח. Propose holding these occurrences under the linguistic-expansion rule; preserve old labels and all human fields. This applies the pilot rationale as a recommendation, not a newly recorded human exclusion.

The inspected departmental medical context conflicts with the stored מספר האיברים בגוף האדם label. Hold the occurrence; ראש מחלקה is a correction hypothesis requiring independent support and approval. Do not classify usage from an old label alone. No whole-type deletion or data correction is performed.

experiment_and_scoring_proposal.systems: Exactly the four same-LLM conditions and one trained Hebrew cross-encoder; no exposure extension or additional model/baseline runs.
experiment_and_scoring_proposal.model_recommendation: Use the existing local Qwen backend with its documented qwen2.5:7b candidate and DictaBERT cross-encoder, if Shaked approves and a later authorized preflight verifies local availability. Pin immutable model/tokenizer revisions or weight digests; the tag alone is insufficient. No availability, Hebrew quality, runtime or memory claim is made here. Do not silently switch to Gemini or another model.
experiment_and_scoring_proposal.llm_settings: Propose zero-shot stateless calls, temperature 0, top_p 1, seed 42 where supported, maximum 64 new tokens; log supported settings and backend version. Use the identical pinned model in all four conditions. Fixed prompt templates are finalized on development before test; no few-shot pilot examples.

conditions.name: generation_sentence

experiment_and_scoring_proposal.raw_input_rule: Read the approved zero-based, end-exclusive span, validate it, and slice the unchanged sentence. Never rediscover the target by first substring match or normalize/strip its prefix using context. Family/type keys are internal leakage metadata and are not handed to no-sentence arms.
experiment_and_scoring_proposal.inventory_order: One frozen inventory per normalized type. Assign canonical IDs after human approval; order by SHA256(seed|candidate|type_key|canonical_id), tie canonical_id. Use the same order for every occurrence and both selection arms. Number 1..N; no 26-letter limit and no per-item shuffle. Candidate order depends on no gold value.
experiment_and_scoring_proposal.generation_normalization: NFC, map typographic Hebrew/curly quote marks to the matching ASCII quote, trim/collapse whitespace, and remove at most one final full stop used as sentence punctuation. No stemming, prefix stripping, global word deletion, global hyphen removal or substring matching. Nontrivial spelling equivalences require an explicit approved alias or blinded rubric judgment.
experiment_and_scoring_proposal.generation_judgment: First exact whole-string match against the frozen canonical/approved aliases. Human-review unmatched outputs in one batch with system/condition concealed as far as format allows. A single unequivocal expression of the same gold linguistic meaning scores 1 even if absent from aliases; wrong sense, entity description only, negation, competing answers, refusal and non-answer score 0. Record raw output, verdict, evidence and reason. Never add a new meaning/candidate or change the gold to improve a model score.
experiment_and_scoring_proposal.selection_parser: Accept only a full stripped string matching [1-9][0-9]* whose integer is <=N. Explanation, multiple positions, negative/out-of-range number, embedded digit or letter is invalid and scores 0. No first-letter scan.
experiment_and_scoring_proposal.missing_and_uncertain: All approved occurrences remain in every denominator. Empty, exhausted-request and invalid outputs score 0 with separate status rates. Allow one identical retry for transport errors only, not poor answers, logging both attempts. Stop on systematic service/configuration failure and resume the missing calls under unchanged settings rather than present an outage as model quality. Any genuinely unresolved generation judgment remains flagged; use strict 0 in the primary score and provide its all-correct upper bound as a sensitivity bound, not as proof the output is wrong.
experiment_and_scoring_proposal.cache: A no-sentence response may be reused only for an identical full prompt/model/settings digest, logged as one unique call linked to all occurrences. Gold correctness can differ by occurrence; caching must not use sentence/gold. Report unique calls separately from item counts.
experiment_and_scoring_proposal.encoder: Same approved inventory and gold IDs and marked occurrence as the LLM. Propose current backbone/pooling cls, max_len 256, batch16, evaluation batch32, learning_rate2e-5, one epoch, seed42; no tuning grid or extension. Seed before model/head construction. Use every approved candidate as positive/negative pair with exactly one positive; train only >=2-candidate types. Development BCE is a training diagnostic, not reported item accuracy. One fixed epoch avoids a new search; save/reload the completed checkpoint, and report task-training uncertainty is not measured by one seed.
experiment_and_scoring_proposal.primary_metric: Macro Top-1 accuracy: average occurrence correctness within each normalized type, then average equally across types. Primary paired contrast is selection_sentence minus generation_sentence. Report micro accuracy and per-type counts descriptively; compare all conditions and encoder on the identical frozen occurrence IDs.
experiment_and_scoring_proposal.secondary_contrasts: Within each formulation, sentence minus no-sentence macro accuracy. Encoder score is a complementary comparison, not an isolated architecture effect. No extra factorial experiment or score-driven subset search.
experiment_and_scoring_proposal.uncertainty: Propose 10,000 paired bootstrap draws of conservative type-family clusters with replacement (seed20260929), retaining all occurrences and all conditions together; recompute the macro statistic with cluster multiplicities. Report percentile 95% intervals for the primary contrast and descriptive context contrasts, plus per-type results. At most one occurrence/document in final evaluation removes repeated-document clusters if document identities are correct. At least20 represented families is a readiness rule, not validated interval coverage or power. No significance threshold, causal claim, equivalence claim from a null result or population-representativeness claim. Bootstrap implementation and coverage remain unverified; do not replace the existing manuscript wording until this proposal is approved.
experiment_and_scoring_proposal.natural_ai: Core training/dev/test above are natural. Keep any future approved AI-authored challenge separate, outside the100 denominator and without pooling. This proposal selects no AI sample and adds no AI experiment.
